strings: Reluctantly, m_c goes to talk to r_c0. The frequent trips to the dirtplace all night have left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} unable to sleep.
With some shock, m_c realises that the sun is rising already, and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/haven't/hasn't} gotten any sleep at all.
Before m_c knows what is happening, it's already morning and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/haven't/hasn't} slept yet.
